services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: Join Sharon Hart for a wide range of activities, including crafting, painting, game creation, & so much more! Each week will focus on boosting your child's curiosity & sense of self, while exploring different media. Featuring special art projects that will encourage your child to explore construction and engage with various artistic media that they can recreate at home! We'll be creating a variety of artworks to celebrate our favourite pop star and the 3 hour long concert she performed over the last year and a half!
